name: crypto-derivs
description: Derivatives Monitor: funding rate (now and 7-day average), open interest and its change since the last run, perp/spot basis, with flags crowded_long, crowded_short, oi_up_price_down, oi_up_price_up. The crypto stand-in for a news monitor: positioning is what moves perps. Use when the user says "check funding", "is it crowded", "open interest", "basis", "who is paying", or before taking a trade.
